agent.problem: The earlier cards give no basis for choosing “falsehood” over “chariots” or “silver,” and little basis for choosing “forgotten” over “tested.” The baker must guess the unseen wording of verse 25 rather than reason out its meaning from the setup.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
